figurative_meaning_en: To see darkness; to become disoriented in danger
example_sentences_in_bangla: ভয়ে তার চোখে সর্ষে ফুল দেখা দিল।
দুর্ঘটনার পর সে বিপদে সর্ষে ফুল দেখতে লাগল।
example_sentences_in_english: In fear, he began seeing flowers in mustard.
After the accident, he became disoriented and saw flowers in mustard in his panic.
history: Originating from rural Bengali agrarian life where mustard plants are common but 'flowers in mustard' symbolizes an impossible or hallucinatory sight due to shock or fear.
note: The idiom draws from the visual imagery of mustard fields in Bengal, emphasizing disorientation in everyday rural contexts.
